summary: Iteration 28 — save-as-template, trusted partner ribbon, employer KYB perks, and admin Verifications panel with reference-answer chips. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass. All 4 frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: projects.py save_project_as_template: correctly guards on `superadmin` OR `customization` scope; support scope returns 403 as required. Uses ±15% band (0.85/1.15) around avg rate — matches spec.

admin.py admin_approve_verification: KYB perks correctly gated by `kyb_perks_granted` flag; hours_balance uses $inc (separate op after $set) — safe. Re-approval leaves perks_granted={} preventing double-credit (verified live).
server.py list_talent: is_trusted_partner correctly computed as completed>=5 AND avg_rating>=4.5 — no seeded talent qualifies (as expected per user note); field shape is present on every row.

projects.py admin_verifications_with_refs: correctly hides `token` field on refs (public-safe); reference_summary counts yes/partial/no/pending correctly. Confirmed live on Test Talent (3 YES / 1 PARTIAL / 4 PENDING chips render).
server.py /api/projects/templates response uses key `templates` (not `items`) — worth noting for future test authors; custom-* templates merge in via _all_project_templates helper.
Docstring says ±20% but implementation uses ±15% (0.85 / 1.15). Cosmetic doc mismatch.
test_credentials: admin@talenthub.io/Admin@2026 (superadmin), support1@jobatlas.io/Support@2026 (support-only), talent@test.io/Talent@2026. Backend tests register a fresh employer kybperks_<hex>@test.io/Test@2026 each run.
seed_data_creation: Each backend run inserts: 1 doc into db.custom_project_templates (custom-test-blueprint-*), 1 project_lead against that template, 1 fresh employer user + associated verification submission (approved). Cleanup selectors: db.custom_project_templates.delete_many({'title':{'$regex':'^Test blueprint'}}); db.users.delete_many({'email':{'$regex':'^kybperks_'}}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter28 pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration28_templates_trust_kyb.py covers: save-as-template (superadmin+support 403), custom template in library + pricing bundle, lead against custom template (must send seat_index in each assigned_team entry — Pydantic requires it), trusted-partner shape check (no seeded talents qualify — is_trusted_partner=false everywhere), fresh-employer KYB approval flow with double-credit guard, and verifications-with-refs scope matrix (moderation+support 200, talent 403). Frontend live-verified: /browse renders 32 talent cards (0 trusted ribbons, matches expectation); /projects/{id}/workspace shows data-testid=save-as-template-btn for admins and window.prompt() flow works; /admin admin-tab-verifications tab renders verifications-panel with all 3 filter chips + Test Talent row showing 3 YES / 1 PARTIAL / 4 PENDING chips + approve/reject buttons.
